rules.name: Unusual High Amount vs Baseline
rules.description: Flags transactions exceeding 3.5 standard deviations or 4x above the customer historical average.

rules.name: High-Frequency Velocity Burst
rules.description: Detects excessive transactions within a short time window (e.g. > 3 transactions within 10 minutes).

rules.name: Geographic Impossible Speed
rules.description: Calculates physical distance and elapsed time between consecutive transactions; flags implied speed > 850 km/h.

rules.name: Preceding Decline Authentication Burst
rules.description: Detects approved high-value transaction preceded by 2 or more declined/failed authorization attempts within 30 minutes.

rules.name: Rapid Fund Depletion / Mule Drain
rules.description: Identifies immediate outbound transfer/withdrawal representing > 80% of customer balance or recent deposit within 30 minutes.

rules.name: Daily Activity Volume Surge
rules.description: Flags when the daily transaction count surges to more than 3.5x the customer’s typical daily frequency.

rules.name: High-Risk Unseen Merchant Ingestion
rules.description: Flags high-value transactions (> $1,200) routed to brand new merchants in high-risk categories (Crypto, Foreign Wire, Gaming).

rules.name: Repeated Identical Amount Probing
rules.description: Identifies 3 or more identical transaction amounts within 15 minutes, indicative of automated card testing or retry script.

rules.name: Off-Hours High-Value Deviation
rules.description: Detects high-value transactions executed between 01:00 and 05:00 local time that deviate from customer normal activity.

rules.name: Suspicious Device Multi-Account Sharing
rules.description: Flags transactions originating from a device ID previously linked to 3 or more distinct customer accounts within 7 days.
